mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post(user_id, content, like_count, favorite_count, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{content}, 0, 0, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.username FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT p.*, u.username FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE post SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE post SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
